SEQ_MOTIF.description: Short sequence motif — PROSITE pattern, ELM linear motif, active-site consensus, targeting signal, kinase-recognition sequence, etc.

SEQ_SIGNAL_PEPTIDE.description: N-terminal secretion / targeting signal peptide (UniProt FT SIGNAL).

SEQ_TRANSIT_PEPTIDE.description: Organelle-targeting transit peptide — mitochondrial, chloroplast, peroxisome, etc. (UniProt FT TRANSIT).

SEQ_PROPEPTIDE.description: Propeptide or zymogen activation segment (UniProt FT PROPEP).

SEQ_INITIATOR_METHIONINE.description: Initiator methionine that is post-translationally removed (UniProt FT INIT_MET).

SEQ_MATURE_CHAIN.description: Mature polypeptide product — the chain remaining after signal / transit / propeptide removal, or a discrete released peptide (UniProt FT CHAIN and PEPTIDE).

SEQ_NONSTANDARD_RESIDUE.description: Non-standard amino acid encoded at a specific position — selenocysteine, pyrrolysine, or curator-annotated modified residues (UniProt FT NON_STD).

SEQ_TARGETING_SIGNAL.description: Short linear targeting / localization signal — nuclear localization/export (NLS/NES), peroxisomal (PTS1/PTS2), ER retention (KDEL), cell-wall sorting (LPXTG), etc. Grounded by ELM TRG classes.

SEQ_LEADER_PEPTIDE.description: N-terminal leader peptide of a ribosomally synthesized precursor (RiPP / bacteriocin leader, lanthipeptide/lasso/sactipeptide leader) that is cleaved to release the mature peptide. Grounded by MIBiG / BAGEL4 / antiSMASH RiPP families.

SEQ_LOW_COMPLEXITY.description: Low-complexity region or compositionally biased segment.

SEQ_DISORDER.description: Intrinsically disordered region (predicted or experimentally validated).

SEQ_REPEAT.description: Tandem sequence repeat (ankyrin, leucine-rich, WD40 sequence repeat, etc.).

SEQ_DOMAIN.description: Domain family defined by a sequence signature — a profile HMM, PSSM, or pattern (Pfam / InterPro / CDD / NCBIfam domain models, MEROPS). The trait's *representation is in sequence space*, so it lives on the SEQUENCE axis even though a domain is a structural unit. Structure-derived domain classifications (CATH / SCOP / ECOD / TED) instead use STRUCT_DOMAIN.

SEQ_FAMILY.description: Protein family defined by a sequence signature (Pfam `Family`-type entries, MEROPS peptidase families). Whole-protein grouping by sequence homology rather than a single domain; representation is a sequence profile. Whole-protein families whose defining property is a conserved *function* (NCBIfam/TIGRFAM equivalog, subfamily) use FUNC_PROTEIN_FAMILY instead.

SEQ_HOMOLOGOUS_SUPERFAMILY.description: Homologous superfamily defined by a sequence signature — Pfam clan, InterPro homologous superfamily, CDD superfamily (cl*). Sequence-space analog of STRUCT_HOMOLOGOUS_SUPERFAMILY (CATH/SCOP), which is reserved for structure-derived superfamilies.

SEQ_COMPOSITION.description: Amino-acid composition trait (e.g. Cys-rich, His-tract, GC-tail).

SEQ_CONSERVATION.description: Conserved sequence region or ultraconserved element.

SEQ_ACTIVE_SITE.description: Catalytic active-site signature detected in sequence — a short conserved residue pattern (e.g. an InterPro Active_site entry). Sequence-local; contrast STRUCT_ACTIVE_SITE (structure-derived, M-CSA-style catalytic residue sets with geometry).

SEQ_BINDING_SITE.description: Ligand/substrate binding-site signature detected in sequence — a short conserved residue pattern (e.g. an InterPro Binding_site entry). Sequence-local; contrast STRUCT_BINDING_SITE (structure/geometry-derived).

SEQ_PTM_SITE.description: Generic sequence-level PTM site — kept as an umbrella bucket for PTM records whose specific modification class is unknown or heterogeneous (e.g. PROSITE patterns that flag multiple PTM families at once). Prefer the specific SEQ_MODIFIED_RESIDUE / SEQ_GLYCOSYLATION_SITE / SEQ_LIPIDATION_SITE / SEQ_CROSSLINK_SITE categories when the modification class is known.

SEQ_MODIFIED_RESIDUE.description: Post-translationally modified residue — phosphorylation, methylation, acetylation, hydroxylation, sulfation, etc. (UniProt FT MOD_RES).

SEQ_GLYCOSYLATION_SITE.description: Glycosylation site — N-linked, O-linked, C-mannosylation, or GPI anchor attachment (UniProt FT CARBOHYD).

SEQ_LIPIDATION_SITE.description: Lipidation site — myristoylation, palmitoylation, prenylation, GPI-lipid anchor, N-acylation (UniProt FT LIPID).

SEQ_CROSSLINK_SITE.description: Inter- or intra-chain cross-link that isn't a disulfide — isopeptide bonds, ubiquitin / SUMO branch points, sortase crosslinks (UniProt FT CROSSLNK).

STRUCT_CLASS.description: Top-level structural class — CATH Class (mainly-α, mainly-β, α/β, few secondary structures) or SCOP class (all-α, all-β, α/β, α+β, multi-domain, membrane, small).

STRUCT_ARCHITECTURE.description: Overall shape of the secondary-structure arrangement, ignoring connectivity — CATH Architecture level (bundle, sandwich, barrel, roll, etc.).

STRUCT_TOPOLOGY.description: Fold topology / connectivity class (TIM barrel, Ig-like, jellyroll, greek key, etc.) — CATH Topology level.

STRUCT_HOMOLOGOUS_SUPERFAMILY.description: Structural + evolutionary grouping below topology — CATH Homologous Superfamily / SCOP Superfamily; members share a common ancestor. Structure-derived only; sequence-signature superfamilies (Pfam clans, InterPro/CDD superfamilies) use SEQ_HOMOLOGOUS_SUPERFAMILY.

STRUCT_FOLD.description: Overall fold cluster (SCOP fold; also emitted for TED novel or highly-symmetric fold representatives). Sibling of STRUCT_TOPOLOGY; use STRUCT_TOPOLOGY when the record is explicitly the CATH topology-level term.

STRUCT_DOMAIN.description: Structure-derived domain classification (CATH domain, SCOP/ECOD domain, TED domain). Domain families defined by a *sequence* signature (Pfam / InterPro / CDD / NCBIfam) use SEQ_DOMAIN instead — the axis follows the representation, not the biology.

STRUCT_SECONDARY.description: Secondary-structure element or arrangement (helix bundle, beta sheet topology).

STRUCT_QUATERNARY.description: Oligomeric / quaternary state (homodimer, hexameric ring, filament).

STRUCT_INTERFACE.description: Subunit or protein-protein interface with defined geometry.

STRUCT_BINDING_SITE.description: Ligand, cofactor, metal, or nucleic-acid binding site.

STRUCT_METAL_SITE.description: Metal-coordinating site (Zn finger, Fe-S cluster, Ca site, etc.).

STRUCT_SYMMETRY.description: Internal or quaternary symmetry (Cn, Dn, icosahedral).

STRUCT_SURFACE.description: Surface property (electrostatic patch, hydrophobicity, glycosylation shield).

MIXED_TRANSMEMBRANE.description: Transmembrane span — sequence hydrophobicity + membrane-embedded helix / strand.

MIXED_COILED_COIL.description: Coiled-coil region — heptad-repeat sequence signature + supercoiled bundle.

MIXED_STRUCTURAL_REPEAT.description: Structural tandem repeat with both sequence and 3D periodicity (Ig, LRR, ankyrin).

FUNC_ENZYMATIC_ACTIVITY.description: Catalytic activity — a chemical reaction the protein performs. Grounded by EC, Rhea, GO MF "*activity", and participant ChEBIs.

FUNC_BINDING_CAPACITY.description: Entry-level ability to bind a class of molecule (ATP-binding, RNA-binding, DNA-binding, etc.). Distinct from STRUCT_BINDING_SITE, which localises the binding to residues. Grounded by GO MF "* binding" or UniProt KW keywords.

FUNC_COFACTOR_REQUIREMENT.description: Non-substrate small molecule (metal ion, prosthetic group, organic cofactor) required for activity. Grounded by ChEBI + UniProt `CC COFACTOR` block.

FUNC_MOLECULAR_FUNCTION.description: A molecular-level activity of a gene product (GO molecular_function) — catalytic, binding, transporter, molecular-carrier, etc. Seeded from the GO MF branch; finer function categories (FUNC_ENZYMATIC_ACTIVITY, FUNC_BINDING_CAPACITY, FUNC_TRANSPORT) capture specific sub-types.

FUNC_LOCALIZATION.description: Subcellular / cellular-component localisation — cytoplasm, plasma membrane, nucleus, extracellular, etc. Grounded by UniProt SubCell and GO CC.

FUNC_ENVIRONMENTAL_RESPONSE.description: Response to (or requirement for) an environmental condition — temperature (cold, heat), pH, salinity, oxygen availability, osmotic pressure, UV, DNA damage, oxidative stress, starvation. Grounded by GO BP `response_to_*` or the UniProt `CC INDUCTION` block.

FUNC_INTERACTION_PARTNER.description: A specific protein-, nucleic-acid-, or complex-partner the protein interacts with (entry-level, not necessarily structurally localised). Distinct from STRUCT_INTERFACE, which captures the interface geometry, and from FUNC_INTERACTION_TYPE (the *kind* of interaction). Grounded by UniProt `CC SUBUNIT` and cross-refs to IntAct / BioGRID / STRING.

FUNC_INTERACTION_TYPE.description: The *kind* of molecular interaction the protein participates in — direct interaction, physical/genetic association, a covalent reaction (ubiquitination, phosphorylation reaction), etc. Grounded by the PSI-MI `interaction type` branch (MI:0190). Distinct from FUNC_INTERACTION_PARTNER, which names *who* is interacted with.

FUNC_TRANSPORT.description: Membrane-transport / translocation capacity — the class of solute or substrate a protein moves across a membrane (channel, carrier, pump, group translocator). Grounded by TCDB, GO MF "* transmembrane transporter activity", and ChEBI substrate.

FUNC_RESISTANCE.description: Antimicrobial-resistance function — the drug/class a protein confers resistance to and the mechanism (efflux, inactivating enzyme, target alteration/protection). Grounded by CARD/ARO, and drug ChEBIs.

FUNC_PATHWAY.description: Membership in a metabolic or signalling pathway / module — an entry-level assertion that the protein participates in a named pathway. Grounded by KEGG (pathway / module / KO), MetaCyc, UniPathway, Reactome, or GO biological-process.

FUNC_ORTHOLOG_GROUP.description: Membership in a cluster of orthologous genes / functional category — the protein belongs to a named orthologous group whose members share a conserved function across taxa. Grounded by COG (NCBI Clusters of Orthologous Genes) and its 26 functional categories, or eggNOG / KEGG Orthology.

FUNC_PROTEIN_FAMILY.description: Whole-protein family whose defining property is a conserved specific *function* — NCBIfam / TIGRFAM `equivalog`, `subfamily`, `exception`, `paralog` models and equivalent full-length functional families. Distinct from FUNC_ORTHOLOG_GROUP (taxon-spanning ortholog cluster) and from SEQ_DOMAIN / SEQ_FAMILY (sequence-signature domain/family whose defining property is the signature, not the function).

EVO_CONSERVATION.description: Cross-taxon conservation state of a protein — conserved (orthologues retained across taxa, optionally scoped to a clade by an NCBITaxon xref), clade-specific / taxonomically restricted (TRG / orphan), or variable / hypervariable / fast-evolving.

EVO_PANGENOME.description: Pangenome partition of a protein within a species/clade pangenome — core, soft-core, shell / accessory, cloud, persistent (PPanGGOLiN), or singleton / strain-specific.

UPPER.description: Upper-level classifier used to organise the hierarchy.
